title: The relay closing note renders the slice
findings_note: s343 and s345 relay runs 2026-10-17: the closing `slicer note ID --text ...` the relay contract and AGENTS.md give has no `--render`, so `slicer check` reported a stale slices/ID.md until an extra `slicer render`
boundary: **Not in this slice:** making `note` render by default, or changing `handoff`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `slicer note` supports `--render`, but the closing note in the relay text and in this repo's AGENTS.md omits it. Several v1.13 orchestrators hit a stale slice render after the note and had to run `slicer render` before committing.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ai.py`: the closing `slicer note ID --text ...` lines in the relay and relay-orchestrator text gain `--render`.
- `AGENTS.md` "Working on the roadmap" block: the note line gains `--render`.
- `tests/test_ai.py` (or the module that pins the relay text); `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `test_AiRelay_ClosingNote_Renders`: every `slicer note` line in `ai relay` and `ai relay-orchestrator` output carries `--render`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the test; watch it go red.
2. Update the text; keep the contract marker unless the meaning of the contract changes.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check (drop `--render` from one line).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
